Note: Update the bank signers in your first two weeks. Our bank asked for signed board minutes naming the new signers and then took three weeks, so we paid the venue for our September event late. We keep three signers: the president, the treasurer and the vice president.
Board meetings are online, on a Tuesday at 7 pm. Attendance went from four of six to all six most months once nobody had to travel. Send the agenda and papers a week ahead.
Book the rooms for the autumn CPE evenings by mid-July, through the university library's events office. The year before, the chapter asked in August and lost its September date.

Send each month's new members a short welcome email in their first week, with the date of the next event. Three of July's new members came to the August study session; before, new members rarely came in their first three months.
The AGM is in May every year. That leaves six weeks to announce the election results, hand over, and tell ISACA who the new leaders are before terms start on July 1.

Start gathering the compliance evidence in early October, before the window opens on November 1. What took longest: approved minutes for every board meeting, the signed Willingness to Serve and Conflict of Interest forms, and the list of bank signers. Keep them in one shared folder all year.

We submitted the annual compliance report on November 18, in the third week of the window (November 1 to December 31). Aim for November: in December, board members are hard to reach for a missing signature.

Our best-attended event of the year was the New Year networking evening with the university's students: 64 people came and 11 joined the chapter afterwards. Hold it again in January, and book the room in November.
Our sponsor contact at the local bank changed in March. The new contact wants a one-page update each quarter: events held, attendance, and what's next. The next one is due in early July.

Election results announced at the AGM on May 19: Watanabe Kenji takes over as president on July 1. Our handover meeting is in the last week of June, and I'm on the board as Immediate Past President all year for questions.
